title: Python Interview Practice — Modules & Packages
topics: Learn how Python loads modules and how import statements expose module names.
Import specific names from a module and understand the difference from plain import.
Use aliases to make imports shorter and avoid naming conflicts.
Practice common modules such as math, random, datetime and os.
Split reusable functions and variables into your own .py modules.
Organize related modules into package directories and import from them.
Control which code runs when a file is executed directly versus imported.
Understand module namespaces, imports, sys.path and name resolution.
Understand installing and using external Python packages safely.
Combine modules with functions, loops, collections, exceptions and OOP.

topicQuestions.question: What is a circular import, and why can it cause problems?
